_readme: Archetypes + reference influencers for Research. Handles have no @. Labels are anonymous, internal only, and never appear in generated content; real handles live ONLY in this file and the DB, never in prompts, playbooks or UI. Blank = platform skipped. Handles were picked from public knowledge and must be confirmed with: pnpm --filter @pseudo/api research:smoke --archetype <slug> --influencer <label>. Then run: pnpm --filter @pseudo/api seed:archetypes

archetypes.name: Trader
archetypes.description: Independent trader lifestyle creator: routines, discipline, markets mindset, luxury city life.
guardrails: Never state or imply specific returns, profits, P&L, account balances or win rates.
Never give financial advice or trade signals; frame as mindset/routine/lifestyle.

archetypes.name: E-commerce Founder
archetypes.description: Online store / DTC brand founder: building products, behind-the-scenes, hustle and lifestyle.
guardrails: Never state or imply revenue, profit or sales numbers, and no fake dashboard screenshots.
No 'get rich' promises, courses or income opportunities.

archetypes.name: Fitness Coach
archetypes.description: Fitness coach creator: training, nutrition habits, discipline, transformation mindset.
guardrails: No medical or nutrition advice presented as professional guidance; no claimed certifications.
No fake before/after transformations or client results/testimonials.
